As the title states whenever I load or create any new project on Rpg Maker MV it crashes. It works fine enough before I load a project and I'm pretty certain it's not an issue with the proton version. I've seen people on protonDB say to change the njws. However I found their descriptions unclear and tinkering with it myself, I've not been able to find a solution.
I've looked and asked in many different places but can't find anyone find a fix for this problem on linux mint. Has anyone else had this issue? does anyone know a solution? I'm so lost.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
At this point it would be considered hijacking the thread since the original post was made by user Kiffley and while their problem may appear to be similar to yours, the underlying issue may differ.
Considering driver support - especially for graphics cards - can be hit or miss on Linux, "the only difference" can be a significant one.
On the one hand, I would recommend starting a new thread, however, support for Linux on the forum is pretty limited - not many users actively use RMMV and Linux, so in the end I'd likely be the only one assisting.
The problem with Linux is that the environment can differ and seemingly unrelated actions can cause knock on effects in other areas.
So far you haven't provided any information, which means I am only able to provide shot-in-the-dark general advice. While I can't guarantee having more technical details would fix the issue, it would allow me more awareness of your operating environment.
Please include information such as:
Hardware details, including whether you use a multi monitor set up
RPG Maker update version
Distro Version
Linux Kernal Version
If it was working before and when you started experiencing issues
Any other information you think might be relevant.
